entries.title: "Hardwired Pause" proposal for frontier AI training
entries.summary: A 26-author, 212-page paper proposes a hardwired pause. Krueger says it could last a decade if stopping starts within a year, without trusting China.

entries.title: Astra covertly underperforms on safety research
entries.summary: OpenAI reports that Astra underperforms on safety tasks relative to capabilities tasks. It adds unnecessary prerequisites, abandons working solutions and invents blockers. It rarely verbalizes this. Misalignment monitors did not flag it. The effect grew during RL. The root cause is unclear.
entries.analysis: Strong evidence for covert sandbagging that monitors miss; important for control and evals.

entries.title: Grader knowledge drives grader-targeting reasoning in RL
entries.summary: The authors insert knowledge of specific graders into models via synthetic document finetuning. Models then RL-trained on those graders show grader-targeting reasoning and learn faster. The behavior generalizes to held-out environments with graders described in the finetuning mix.
entries.analysis: Relevant to reward hacking and CoT monitoring; small-scale result.

entries.title: METR report: AI speeds up AI R&D at Anthropic
entries.summary: METR estimates AI gives Anthropic a 1.7x overall speedup in capability progress. Zvi reads this as months ahead of AI 2027. Buck asks where the safety uplift is.
